notes.title: Shadowhand Solitaire - Multi-Language Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/afa193882a6afa3257d6f6d873514bf160ed77f3.png"]

You can now change language for Shadowhand Solitaire on Steam via the options screen. 

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Shadowhand Solitaire in your chosen language!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: V1.11 update for Steam Deck
notes.notes:
This update is mostly for improvements for Steam Deck so that we can hopefully get a green tick for it.

- Steam Deck: Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- Steam Deck: If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Steam Deck: The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name.
- Steam Deck: The game no longer closes down in full screen mode if More Games or Newsletter buttons are clicked.

Other improvements:
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.
- Updated steam_api.dll and Steamstub.dll
- You can now pass in command line arguments (Steam Launch Options) to change the save data location as follows: SaveInDocuments or SaveInAppData or SaveInCGames or SaveInExeFolder

notes.title: V1.10 Update
notes.notes:
V1.09:
- Prevented name entry with non-latin characters (e.g Russian) as it causes a problem with the save data.

V1.10:
- Added Borderless Window to options screen. It's only available when Full Screen is not selected.
- Added BORDERLESS WINDOW=1 to the default.ini file.
- Defringed checkbox and slider graphics so they looked better on Options screen.
- Defringed embossed font so it looks better on Options screen.
- Clicking Newsletter and More Games no longer closes the game to open the browser unless you are in full screen mode.
- Fixed game screen background looking pixelated after changing from windowed mode to fullscreen mode.
- Fixed minor graphical glitch with the powerup fill line when not running the game in windowed mode.
- Tweaked powerup fill line width when nearly full to make sure it goes to the edge of the frame.
- Steam: Fixed an issue where running the game for the first time would show a dialog saying "Starting in Windowed mode due to incorrect shutdown."
- If the game is closed incorrectly (e.g. from a crash) it will now show a dialog on boot that allows the player to try out an OpenGL graphics driver instead of DirectX, which may work better on some Intel video cards.
- Fixed OpenGL windowed mode so it has a title bar.
- If the game fails to save data it now shows an error message advising players to exclude/whitelist the game/save data folder in their virus killer or One Drive.

Please note: this update is for Windows only.
